title: Team Leader / Sale Manager-Personal Loan
description:
Team Leader / Sales Manager – Personal Loan

Key Responsibilities:

\* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Personal Loan sales executives.

\* Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve monthly and quarterly targets.

\* Drive personal loan acquisition through various channels such as branch, corporate, open market, and direct sales.

\* Monitor individual and team performance regularly and ensure achievement of assigned targets.

\* Train and coach team members on product knowledge, customer engagement, lead conversion, and closing techniques.

\* Ensure proper documentation and adherence to KYC and process guidelines.

\* Identify new business opportunities and implement effective lead generation strategies.

\* Coordinate with internal teams such as operations, credit, underwriting, and disbursement teams for smooth loan processing.

\* Track applications, approvals, disbursements, and overall sales performance.

\* Prepare and maintain daily/weekly MIS and performance reports for management review.

\* Ensure a high level of customer service and maintain good customer relationships.

\* Ensure the team follows company policies, sales processes, and compliance requirements.

Exp : 3+ yrs in core product with team handling
